SchoolMakerAPIKeyCredential.title: SchoolMaker API Key
SchoolMakerAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In SchoolMaker, open Settings → Integration & API and copy the API key. API access requires a Pro or Business plan. Paste the key alone; NoClick sends it as a bearer token.

SchoolMakerListConversationGroupsConfig.description: List Conversation Groups. One request to the published API operation.

user_id.description: Required ID of the user whose conversation history to retrieve. The user must belong to your school.
user_id.title: User Id

page.description: Page number. Follow next_page until null.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Maximum number of results per page.
per_page.title: Per Page

search.description: Search title, non-deleted message content, or participant name/email.
search.title: Search

member_id.description: Filter the selected user's conversations by a participating member ID.
member_id.title: Member Id

participant_user_id.description: Filter the selected user's conversations by another participating user ID.
participant_user_id.title: Participant User Id

email.description: Filter by a participant's email, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. No match returns no conversations. When several participant filters are supplied, any match is included.
email.title: Email

filter.description: Filter the selected user's conversations by unread, followed or archived status, or by step completion.
filter.title: Filter

archived.description: Use true for archived conversations only or false to exclude them. Can be combined with another filter. filter=archived takes precedence.
archived.title: Archived

sort.description: Sort by latest activity by default. Matching activity dates are ordered by conversation ID.
sort.title: Sort

id.title: Id

user_id.description: Required ID of the user whose conversation history to retrieve. The user must belong to your school.
user_id.title: User Id

page.description: Page number. Follow next_page until null.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of messages per page, defaulting to 10. Accepts 1 to 30 but returns at most 10.
per_page.title: Per Page

search.description: Search non-deleted message content. Deleted message bodies are excluded.

SchoolMakerListMembersConfig.description: List Members or Get a Member. One request to the published API operation.

id.description: If provided, returns the member with this ID instead of a list.
id.title: Id

email.description: If provided (and id not given), returns the member with this email instead of a list.
email.title: Email

min_points.description: Minimum all-time points, inclusive. Members without points count as zero. Requires leaderboards to be enabled. Omit or leave blank for no minimum.
min_points.title: Min Points

max_points.description: Maximum all-time points, inclusive. Requires leaderboards to be enabled. Omit or leave blank for no maximum.
max_points.title: Max Points

min_level.description: Minimum current level, inclusive. Members without level history count as level 1. Requires levels to be enabled. Omit or leave blank for no minimum.
min_level.title: Min Level

max_level.description: Maximum current level, inclusive. Requires levels to be enabled. Omit or leave blank for no maximum.
max_level.title: Max Level

min_coaching_used.description: Minimum coaching usage, inclusive. Requires coaching_type_id. Measured in hours for timed coaching or sessions otherwise, including future published appointments. No appointments count as zero. Omit or leave blank for no minimum.
min_coaching_used.title: Min Coaching Used

max_coaching_used.description: Maximum coaching usage, inclusive. Requires coaching_type_id. Measured in hours for timed coaching or sessions otherwise, including future published appointments. No appointments count as zero. Omit or leave blank for no maximum.
max_coaching_used.title: Max Coaching Used

consultation_category_id.description: Filter by current offer access to this consultation category. Excludes expired, inactive or deleted accesses and deleted offers. Subscriptions must be active or trialing. Omit or leave blank for no filter.
consultation_category_id.title: Consultation Category Id

live_category_id.description: Filter by current offer access to this live category. Excludes expired, inactive or deleted accesses and deleted offers. Subscriptions must be active or trialing. Omit or leave blank for no filter.
live_category_id.title: Live Category Id

coaching_type_id.description: Filter by current offer access to this coaching type. Excludes expired, inactive or deleted accesses and deleted offers. Subscriptions must be active or trialing. Omit or leave blank for no filter.
coaching_type_id.title: Coaching Type Id

ai_assistant_id.description: Filter by current offer access to this AI coach. Excludes expired, inactive or deleted accesses and deleted offers. Subscriptions must be active or trialing. Omit or leave blank for no filter.
ai_assistant_id.title: Ai Assistant Id
